projectOverrides.toolchain: Preserve Swift language mode5, iOS17 deployment and actual CI Xcode26.3/SDK26.2. Skills do not authorize Swift6.4, SDK27 or deployment migration; verify each new API in primary Apple docs/SDK.
coreml: Preserve exact current model/source hashes, FP32 arithmetic, CPU-only shipping configuration and lexical/frame/PCM accuracy gates. Actual Noor CPU-vs-ALL measurements override generic ALL/ANE performance claims.

Measure actual cold/warm hash/load, input preparation, MLModel.prediction and postdecode separately on permitted macOS CI. Simulator results do not establish physical iPhone/ANE performance. No new job, model or precision change follows merely from installing a skill.

Keep synchronous inference off MainActor in existing worker ownership. Preserve single-flight preparation, cancellation and generation barriers; do not copy generic reference MainActor classify/detect, configuration-blind cache or background unload/reload policies.

Guard MLComputePlan at iOS17.4 and MLTensor/MLState at iOS18; retain existing iOS17 paths. No Float16/compression/compute-unit substitution without separate source-bound parity and performance evidence.
motion: Only short, scoped, value-driven feedback from actual UI/audio state; native iOS17 phase/keyframe APIs where justified. Preserve system/app Reduce Motion and interrupted/repeated interaction behavior.

Stop transient effects on finish, disappearance and background. No unbounded animation loops, new dependencies, fake meter/ASR progress, or animation of Quran text, word positions or evidence geometry.
Gate newer symbol/navigation effects. No display link, forced frame-rate guarantee, unconditional drawingGroup or Core Animation bridge without measured need.
accessibility: Use semantic controls with meaningful Arabic labels/states, at least 44-point targets, Dynamic Type, RTL, contrast and intentional traversal/focus. Inspect heard-header readability and single microphone start/finish states.
Do not announce meter changes every render or confuse capture/listening state with confirmed recognition. Guard iOS18 Assistive Access examples.

Windows source checks, helper tests, screenshot fixtures and XCTest metadata do not replace actual native readability, assistive-technology or live microphone/ASR proof. App Store claims require their own common-task evidence.
projectOverrides.license: Preserve each copied PolyForm Perimeter 1.0.0 LICENSE and required notices. Do not label it MIT; do not install collections, hooks, upstream scripts or new MCP/access.
projectOverrides.precedence: Current owner charter, local Noor skills, architecture/deadlines and acceptance ledger override generic external recipes. Skill installation itself closes no product or evidence gate.
